name: NEWSROOM_ACTIVE_MODEL
purpose: Model name the Rust launcher passes to the Pi child; the runtime records it as the model in vision-critic review records.

name: NEWSROOM_ACTIVE_PROVIDER
purpose: Provider name the Rust launcher passes to the Pi child; the runtime writes it into the vision-critic review record.

name: NEWSROOM_AGENT
purpose: Selects the Rust agent runtime only when exactly 'rust'; 'pi' keeps the old one.

name: NEWSROOM_AGENTIC_OUT
purpose: Output folder of the agentic qualification script; default .newsroom/agentic-qualification under the repo.

name: NEWSROOM_AGENTIC_SCENARIO_ID
purpose: Scenario name for the agentic qualification run; default renewable-energy-open-goal-v1.

name: NEWSROOM_AGENT_COMMAND
purpose: Passes the parent's command name to the Rust agent child.

name: NEWSROOM_AGENT_LOCAL_URL
purpose: Address of the local stand-in model; only 127.0.0.1 or localhost.

name: NEWSROOM_AGENT_REAL
purpose: Gate A: lets the Rust child run against a real model, exact 1 only.

name: NEWSROOM_APIKEY
purpose: Example credential-looking name the tool host filters out of tools.

name: NEWSROOM_API_KEY
purpose: Generic model-provider API key override, used when no provider-specific key is set.

name: NEWSROOM_ARTIFACTS_DIR
purpose: Folder where run bundles are stored; default .newsroom/artifacts.

name: NEWSROOM_ARTIFACT_DIR
purpose: Names the run folder; group call checks need it to be known.

name: NEWSROOM_ASSET_REFS_RESOLVE
purpose: An asset requirement marked available counts only when every source_refs entry resolves to an ordinary file of this run (any folder but staging/); a name the model typed is refused with the reason. Remove the "0" off value after the first verified real full-page run.

name: NEWSROOM_AUTH
purpose: Example name the tool host's credential-name rule does not catch.

name: NEWSROOM_AXIS_NICE_MAX
purpose: Value axis ends on a whole tick, exact 1 only.

name: NEWSROOM_BAR_LABEL_UNIT
purpose: Row labels drop the unit the axis already shows.

name: NEWSROOM_BAR_REF_DOMAIN
purpose: A reference line past the longest bar widens the value axis.

name: NEWSROOM_BAR_ZERO_MARK
purpose: Zero-value bars get a visible 3px tick at the zero line.

name: NEWSROOM_BASE_RECORD_COMMIT
purpose: Commit to record base test output against; set only by the fixture generator.

name: NEWSROOM_BASE_RECORD_WT
purpose: Old-tree worktree for recording base test output; set only by the fixture generator.

name: NEWSROOM_BASE_URL
purpose: Generic model-provider base address override, used when no provider-specific address is set.

name: NEWSROOM_BASIS_TEXT_BODY
purpose: Lets the one basis panel carry a text body of method words.

name: NEWSROOM_BENCH_ITERATIONS
purpose: Iteration count of the chart-renderer benchmark; default 120.

name: NEWSROOM_BENCH_SAMPLES
purpose: Samples per case in the local-backend benchmark; default 12.

name: NEWSROOM_BIGGER_CHARTS
purpose: Makes Sankey node bars and bands larger on desktop.

name: NEWSROOM_BROWSER_QA_TIMEOUT_MS
purpose: Time limit in milliseconds for the browser-check process; default 120000.

name: NEWSROOM_CAUSAL_PHRASES_EN
purpose: Also refuses "as a result of" as unbound causal language in a claim.

name: NEWSROOM_CHAIN_FINGERPRINT_AT_PASS
purpose: A passing verification record also stores the chart fingerprint the follow-up run compares.

name: NEWSROOM_CHAIN_STOP_VIA_VISUAL
purpose: The page chain's stop path asks the visual group's lint command for the page lint instead of calling the lint internals itself. Remove the "0" off value after the first verified real full-page run.

name: NEWSROOM_CHANNEL_AXES
purpose: Channel list also offers position_x and position_y.

name: NEWSROOM_CHART_TEXT_WORDS
purpose: Refuses number words in every chart's title, subtitle, alt and source line.

name: NEWSROOM_CHOROPLETH_NORMALIZED
purpose: A choropleth must map a ratio, share or per-capita value whose divisor is a data column that differs by region; a total, a constant divisor, a divisor that is a single total over all rows, or a column with no declared denominator is refused. Approved default on by owner 10-18; until symbol_map exists, refused totals fall back to horizontal_bar. Remove the "0" off value after the first verified real full-page run.

name: NEWSROOM_CHORO_BADGE_CLEAR
purpose: Choropleth badges keep clear of highlight outlines.

name: NEWSROOM_CHORO_LEADER_CLEARANCE
purpose: Choropleth leaders stay 2px clear of accepted label boxes.

name: NEWSROOM_CHORO_LEDGER_SIZE
purpose: Choropleth numbered list set at 16px with 20px rows.

name: NEWSROOM_CHORO_LIST_COMPACT
purpose: Choropleth numbered list uses 8 rows per column instead of 12.

name: NEWSROOM_CHORO_TETHER_CLEAR
purpose: Choropleth tethers start outside their own number's text box.

name: NEWSROOM_CLAIM_SQL_LINT
purpose: Opt-in lint: a claim's SQL may not type a number directly.

name: NEWSROOM_COLUMN_CHART_NOTICE
purpose: A request that names a column chart (柱状图, 柱形图, column chart) gets one sentence in the prompt: only horizontal bar forms exist, so the model draws the horizontal form and says vertical columns are not available yet. Model-visible notice; no check is changed. Remove the "0" off value after the first verified real full-page run.

name: NEWSROOM_COMPLETION_GAP_HINTS
purpose: Correction names the tool that supplies each missing item.

name: NEWSROOM_COMPLETION_PLAN_GAP
purpose: Run needing the complex-visual chain flags a gap while plan.json is missing.

name: NEWSROOM_COMPLEX_BENCH_ITERATIONS
purpose: Iteration count of the complex-chart benchmark; default 100.

name: NEWSROOM_COMPLEX_VISUAL_ROUTING_AB
purpose: Turns on the A/B routing of complex visual requests when set to 1, true or split; any other value leaves it off.

name: NEWSROOM_COMPLEX_VIZ_P95_MS
purpose: p95 time budget in milliseconds for the complex-chart benchmark; default 18.

name: NEWSROOM_CONCEPT_COUNT_3
purpose: Comparison switch: 3 to 20 concepts instead of 8 to 20.

name: NEWSROOM_CREDENTIALS
purpose: Example credential-looking name in the tool host's key-name test; not read as a switch.

name: NEWSROOM_D3_PLAN_REFUSAL
purpose: Stricter rule, owner approved 10-18 morning: newsroom_publication_plan and newsroom_portable_publication refuse a module of type d3 at the plan step (naming every d3 module and the plotly values to use) while no D3 runtime ships; before this the plan was accepted and the page render failed later. Ends by itself when a D3 library is embedded. Remove the "0" off value after the first verified real full-page run.

name: NEWSROOM_DATA_NOTES
purpose: Shows a data source's status flags, such as estimated or provisional.

name: NEWSROOM_DEMO_API_KEY
purpose: Example credential-looking name in the tool host's environment-filter test, which expects it dropped; not read as a switch.

name: NEWSROOM_DOCKER_IMAGE
purpose: Image name built by the live-in-docker script; default agentic-data-newsroom:1.13.0-rc1.

name: NEWSROOM_DOWNLOAD_FROZEN
purpose: Replay tests only: serves a listed download URL from a frozen, hash-checked copy in the run folder, marks the data file and the publication manifest as frozen data, and verification reports it as a finding, never a pass. Remove when the three-topic replays (#63) close.

name: NEWSROOM_DUCKDB_BIN
purpose: Path to the DuckDB program that runs the SQL; default duckdb.

name: NEWSROOM_DUCKDB_BUNDLED_EXT
purpose: Adds DuckDB arguments that load allow-listed bundled extensions.

name: NEWSROOM_DUCKDB_EXT_DIR
purpose: Absolute folder holding the bundled DuckDB extensions.

name: NEWSROOM_EMBED_MIN_TEXT
purpose: Stops desktop-embedded charts shrinking their smallest text too far.

name: NEWSROOM_ENV_FILE
purpose: Points the CLI at an external config file instead of .env.

name: NEWSROOM_EVEN_SPLIT_PICTOGRAM
purpose: Refuses a one-day clock picture that spreads identical people evenly.

name: NEWSROOM_EXTENSION
purpose: Rust constant holding the embedded runtime source that is written to the run folder; not an environment variable.

name: NEWSROOM_EXTREME_NOTE
purpose: When the extreme-value probe fires, adds one sentence to the chart note.

name: NEWSROOM_EXTREME_PROBE
purpose: Report-only probe for one value far away from all others.

name: NEWSROOM_FAULT_INJECT_TOOL_ONCE
purpose: Test-only: fails the named tool once per run folder; unset means no fault; the qualification script sets duckdb_query.

name: NEWSROOM_FETCH_SPLIT_PROBE
purpose: Writes a fetch diagnostic after the request; changes nothing else.

name: NEWSROOM_FETCH_WELLFORMED_CUT
purpose: Cuts fetched text on well-formed boundaries instead of plain slice.

name: NEWSROOM_FIRST_TRY_DECLARE
purpose: Refusal also names the declarations the reader task already chose.

name: NEWSROOM_FIRST_TRY_ENUMS
purpose: Enum fields carry their allowed words in their descriptions.

name: NEWSROOM_FIRST_TRY_PANELS
purpose: Storyboard refusals list panel kinds and page-order rules.

name: NEWSROOM_FIRST_TRY_PUBLISH
purpose: Two publication refusals name more, including the bound visual thesis.

name: NEWSROOM_FIRST_TRY_WORDING
purpose: Number-word refusals name every matched word.

name: NEWSROOM_FIXTURE
purpose: Data file used by the qualification scripts; default fixtures/world-bank-renewable-latest.csv.

name: NEWSROOM_FLOW_EXTENT_HINT
purpose: Plan says to leave extent_mode out so the program picks it.

name: NEWSROOM_FLOW_MAPS_BACK
purpose: Takes cartographic flow maps off the held list, with the hold on.

name: NEWSROOM_FLOW_MAP_AUTO_EXTENT
purpose: Flow map without extent_mode fits data when endpoints share one region.

name: NEWSROOM_FLOW_MAP_LABELS
purpose: Turns on flow map labels; a spec field alone does nothing.

name: NEWSROOM_FLOW_STYLE_CIRCLES
purpose: Draws a circle at each flow origin, sized by that flow's value.

name: NEWSROOM_FLOW_STYLE_TRUNK
purpose: Merges flows into one destination into a trunk, width summed.

name: NEWSROOM_FOLLOWUP_COMPLETION_GATE
purpose: A failed follow-up round records that failure, not the previous pass.

name: NEWSROOM_FOLLOWUP_PRIMARY_LATEST
purpose: After a follow-up, primary_artifact names the newest chart that passed checks.

name: NEWSROOM_FOLLOWUP_SAME_SETTINGS
purpose: Follow-up runs carry over the speed and merge settings.

name: NEWSROOM_FORM_SKILL
purpose: Turns on the program's form-selection step.

name: NEWSROOM_GRAMMAR_COVER_PREFLIGHT
purpose: Opt-in plan preflight for grammar coverage.

name: NEWSROOM_GRAMMAR_HINT_ELIGIBLE
purpose: Refusal hints name only grammar sets the page's evidence allows. Remove the "0" off value after the first verified real full-page run.

name: NEWSROOM_GRAPH_EXTRACTORS
purpose: Comma list of graph extractors declared available; when non-empty it replaces the Python import probe for graphrag.

name: NEWSROOM_GROUP_BOUNDARY
purpose: Enables the group boundary report; this switch only reports.

name: NEWSROOM_GROUP_CALL_CHECK
purpose: Call report also records per-tool allow and pin rows. Remove the "0" off value after the first verified real full-page run.

name: NEWSROOM_GROUP_CALL_REFUSE
purpose: Refuses a tool call that is off its tool_allow or tool_pin row. Remove the "0" off value after the first verified real full-page run.

name: NEWSROOM_GROUP_CALL_REFUSE_ALL
purpose: Every wrapped function with a cross-call row refuses a caller outside its list. Remove the "0" off value after the first verified real full-page run.

name: NEWSROOM_GROUP_CALL_REFUSE_NOTOOL
purpose: Also refuses gated calls made with no asking tool.

name: NEWSROOM_GROUP_COMMANDS
purpose: Turns on the group commands; only exact 1 counts.

name: NEWSROOM_GROUP_ENFORCE
purpose: Refuses writes by a tool outside its owning group. Remove the "0" off value after the first verified real full-page run.

name: NEWSROOM_GROUP_EXEMPT_RECORD
purpose: Records writes that skip the group check because of an exemption; record only.

name: NEWSROOM_GROUP_HANDOFF_OBSERVE
purpose: Command-side handoff gate only records, never refuses.

name: NEWSROOM_GROUP_REVIEW_FROM_RECORDS
purpose: A review counts only if the program saved its record.

name: NEWSROOM_GROUP_TOOLS
purpose: Routes every tool through one group check; needs ENFORCE. Remove the "0" off value after the first verified real full-page run.

name: NEWSROOM_GROUP_TOOLS_HASH_ALL
purpose: Hashes every watched-folder file so same-size rewrites are seen.

name: NEWSROOM_GROUP_TOOL_ORDER
purpose: Lists tools to the model in group order, with group labels.

name: NEWSROOM_GUIDE_ERRORS
purpose: Rewrites the text of two misleading width blockers; what is blocked stays the same.

name: NEWSROOM_HEADER_BOX_INK
purpose: Section header box ends where the next module starts, on every page.

name: NEWSROOM_HEATMAP_LOG_COLOR
purpose: Heatmap cell colour follows the log of the value when color_scale is log.

name: NEWSROOM_HEATMAP_TIDY
purpose: Turns on the tidy heatmap format with a shared decimal count for cells and legend.

name: NEWSROOM_HEATMAP_VALUE_LABELS
purpose: Every non-null heatmap cell must show its exact value as legible text.

name: NEWSROOM_HELD_CHART_TYPES
purpose: Holds four chart types (tree, flow maps, trajectory) out of the tools when on.

name: NEWSROOM_HERO_GLYPH_WIDTH
purpose: Estimates bold serif numerals and minus signs wider so the unit does not collide.

name: NEWSROOM_HERO_RECOMPUTE
purpose: A hero number must equal the value the program recomputes from the rows.

name: NEWSROOM_HERO_SIZE_UP
purpose: Draws the hero numeral at the larger heroNumeralSize; unit keeps its ratio.

name: NEWSROOM_HERO_THOUSANDS
purpose: Writes plain-digit hero numbers of five or more places with thousands separators.

name: NEWSROOM_ILLUSTRATION_ADAPTER
purpose: Approved executable for illustration generation; unset means no adapter runs.

name: NEWSROOM_ILLUSTRATION_ADAPTER_ARGS_JSON
purpose: JSON argument list passed to the illustration adapter executable.

name: NEWSROOM_INTERACTIVE_STORY
purpose: Conversation picks the long-story or quick tool profile per topic; :story and :quick force it.

name: NEWSROOM_KEY
purpose: Test fixture name that the credential-name rule must treat as a credential.

name: NEWSROOM_KEYBOARD_MODE
purpose: Test fixture name that must not count as a credential.

name: NEWSROOM_LAYOUT_IGNORED_FIELDS
purpose: Plan preflight that reports layout fields the renderer ignores; reports only.

name: NEWSROOM_LEAN_GATES
purpose: Lean gate path: model picks primary and supporting grammar; program derives the rest.

name: NEWSROOM_LEGEND_TICK_FIT
purpose: Legend tick labels kept only when their measured boxes do not touch.

name: NEWSROOM_LINE_END_LABEL_FIT
purpose: Splits or right-aligns a line-end label that would cross the right edge.

name: NEWSROOM_LINE_TICK_AVOID_OVERLAP
purpose: Drops middle tick labels whose boxes would touch an already kept label.

name: NEWSROOM_LIVE_OUT
purpose: Output folder for the live integration qualification run.

name: NEWSROOM_LOCAL_SOURCE_NOTE
purpose: Chart source line uses the user's own data-file note instead of the model's text.

name: NEWSROOM_LOCATION_EVIDENCE
purpose: Unless the value is exactly 0, a choropleth writes the location evidence its own name join proved; verified_locations is accepted only from that, not from model self-report. While NEWSROOM_SYMBOL_MAP is on, turning this off leaves the symbol-map anchor check unchecked and it only warns. Exactly 0 turns it off; any other value, an empty value or false included, leaves it on. Remove the "0" off value after the first verified real full-page run.

name: NEWSROOM_MAP_FLOW_SUPPORT
purpose: Thematic map pages may take FLOW_LEDGER as a supporting grammar.

name: NEWSROOM_MAP_WORLD
purpose: Turns on whole-world map mode (map_extent world).

name: NEWSROOM_MAP_WORLD_LIST
purpose: World list mode: unlabelled countries are printed once in a grouped list under the map.

name: NEWSROOM_MODEL
purpose: Model name read by the agentic evaluation scripts; no default.

name: NEWSROOM_MODEL_PASS_SELFREPORT
purpose: Model-reported passes and scores are recorded as self-reported and never count.

name: NEWSROOM_MYKEY
purpose: Example name the credential-name rule does not catch.

name: NEWSROOM_NAMED_HIGHLIGHT_PARTIAL
purpose: A non-empty highlight_values no longer ends the highlight check.

name: NEWSROOM_NEWS_BIN
purpose: Path to the news binary used by the provider preflight script.

name: NEWSROOM_NOTE_URL_LINE
purpose: Puts a URL in the footer on its own line.

name: NEWSROOM_NUMBER_AUDIT_LOG
purpose: Record only, default off (exactly 1 turns it on). During verify, writes one shadow/record_number_audit-<key>.json listing each number in claim and publication text and whether it equals a cell or derived value of the related computations; a match is not a verification, and nothing is refused or changed.

name: NEWSROOM_NUMWORD_CONTEXT
purpose: Position-only number words, such as 四周 meaning all around, are not counted.

name: NEWSROOM_NUMWORD_PROMPT
purpose: In complex visual requests, a rule before writing says where number words are refused. Remove the "0" off value after the first verified real full-page run.

name: NEWSROOM_ONE_CHART_ROUTING
purpose: Routing change, no check loosened or tightened (explicitly requested chart modes stay required): a request that says it wants one chart goes to the single-chart flow even if it also names a page (unless it names two or more chart modes), and the page tool text says to pair a single chart with one explanatory module. Remove the "0" off value after the first verified real full-page run.

name: NEWSROOM_ONE_NUMBERING
purpose: Pages whose sections are already numbered do not number their modules a second time.

name: NEWSROOM_OUTPUT_DIR
purpose: Output folder setting accepted from a project .env file.

name: NEWSROOM_PAGE_MODULE_ORDER_CHECK
purpose: Plan preflight checks that printed module numbers increase in layout order; penalty only.

name: NEWSROOM_PAGE_OCR_CHECK
purpose: Runtime-only OCR read-back of a rendered page; writes a report only.

name: NEWSROOM_PAGE_POLISH
purpose: Page polish rules: embedded section titles, full-width big-number bars, meaning-based colours.

name: NEWSROOM_PAGE_QA_NESTED_CLIP
purpose: Checks that text inside a nested svg lies inside that svg's box.

name: NEWSROOM_PAGE_TRIM_TEXT_SAFE
purpose: Counts every glyph as a full em when trimming page text.

name: NEWSROOM_PALETTE_BY_THEME
purpose: Topic-driven muted or bright colour families for charts and page shells.

name: NEWSROOM_PASS
purpose: Example name the credential-name rule does not catch.

name: NEWSROOM_PASSWD
purpose: Test fixture name that the credential-name rule must treat as a credential.

name: NEWSROOM_PDFTOTEXT_BIN
purpose: Path to the pdftotext binary used for PDF text extraction.

name: NEWSROOM_PERF_ENV_FILE
purpose: Required external env file for the live performance script.

name: NEWSROOM_PERF_PI_BIN
purpose: Required Pi executable for the live performance scripts.

name: NEWSROOM_PERF_PROVIDER
purpose: Required provider name for the live performance scripts.

name: NEWSROOM_PHASE
purpose: Comma-separated list of run phases to enable; default all.

name: NEWSROOM_PHASES
purpose: Name fragment of the Rust constant VALID_NEWSROOM_PHASES, the list of valid phase names; the environment variable read is NEWSROOM_PHASE.

name: NEWSROOM_PHASE_METRICS
purpose: Writes one JSON phase-scope metric line per tool to stderr.

name: NEWSROOM_PHASE_METRICS_FILE
purpose: Extra file that also receives the phase metric lines, outside the run folder.

name: NEWSROOM_PI_BIN
purpose: Pi executable to run; defaults to pi.

name: NEWSROOM_PI_MODEL
purpose: Model name the Pi agent uses; defaults to claude-sonnet-4-6.

name: NEWSROOM_PI_OFFLINE
purpose: Pi child skips its own background model-catalog refresh.

name: NEWSROOM_PI_PROVIDER
purpose: Provider the Pi agent uses; defaults to dragoncode.

name: NEWSROOM_PI_THINKING
purpose: Thinking level passed to the Pi agent.

name: NEWSROOM_PREFLIGHT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
purpose: Timeout in seconds for the provider preflight; defaults to 90.

name: NEWSROOM_PROVIDER
purpose: Provider name read by the preflight and agentic evaluation scripts; no default.

name: NEWSROOM_PROVIDER_MATRIX
purpose: Required provider:model list for the provider matrix script.

name: NEWSROOM_PROVIDER_MATRIX_OUT
purpose: Output folder for the provider matrix run.

name: NEWSROOM_PUBLICATION_EMBED_PAGE
purpose: A publication module may embed the composed infographic page itself.

name: NEWSROOM_PUBLICATION_STYLE_COMPAT
purpose: With no style_profile given, pick the render's compatible style profile.

name: NEWSROOM_PYTHON_BIN
purpose: Python interpreter for spreadsheet conversion; defaults to python3.

name: NEWSROOM_QA_DIRECTIONAL_FONT_SCALE
purpose: Measures text at the smallest directional font scale.

name: NEWSROOM_QA_FINITE_DATA_VALUE
purpose: A data-value that is not a plain finite decimal reads as NaN and fails.

name: NEWSROOM_QA_HEATMAP_MONOTONE
purpose: Heatmap fill must get darker as the cell value grows; equal values share a colour.

name: NEWSROOM_QA_LIMITS_PROGRAM
purpose: The program sets the browser-check width, page-size limit and ready-time limit; newsroom_publication_plan takes none of them. Remove the "0" off value after the first verified real full-page run.

name: NEWSROOM_QA_NO_EMPTY_PASS
purpose: A render-QA rule with nothing to check is reported as not a pass, and an all-zero chart is refused. Remove the "0" off value after the first verified real full-page run.

name: NEWSROOM_QA_SHARED_WIDTH
purpose: Combining marks and zero-width joiners add no advance in the width estimate.

name: NEWSROOM_QA_TICK_READBACK
purpose: Reads back bar tick and value labels on bar charts.

name: NEWSROOM_RECORD_ASOF_LISTS
purpose: Records subject lists cut off by date but filtered on status (record only).

name: NEWSROOM_RECORD_CAVEATS
purpose: Records caveats that never reach the page (record only).

name: NEWSROOM_RECORD_CRITIC_VISION
purpose: Records whether the reviewing model can see the preview (record only).

name: NEWSROOM_RECORD_DROPPED_CONTENT
purpose: Records content that disappears without a refusal (record only).

name: NEWSROOM_RECORD_EXTREME_WORDS
purpose: Records extreme, first and only words on the page (record only).

name: NEWSROOM_RECORD_NUMBERS
purpose: Records numbers in positions the comparison does not read (record only).

name: NEWSROOM_RECORD_ORIGIN_HASH
purpose: Record-only side output of verify; no check or exit code changes.

name: NEWSROOM_RECORD_THIN_RESULT
purpose: Record-only side output of verify for thin results; no check or exit code changes.

name: NEWSROOM_REFUSAL_FIELDS
purpose: A refused chart plan also carries, per problem, the field path, the rule and the allowed values or range its own words state, as a [refusal] line after the text and an error property. The refusal and its rule are unchanged. Remove the "0" off value after the first verified real full-page run.

name: NEWSROOM_REFUSED_OPTIONS_FIX
purpose: Writes the conditions the checks enforce into the tool descriptions the model reads. Remove the "0" off value after the first verified real full-page run.

name: NEWSROOM_RENDER_STYLES
purpose: Re-draws the finished chart SVG in its house, riso or pencil render style.

name: NEWSROOM_REPEAT_FAILURE_STOP
purpose: Ends a run after five identical failing calls of the same tool.

name: NEWSROOM_REQUIRE_NO_SKIP
purpose: A test section that needs a missing tool fails instead of printing SKIP.

name: NEWSROOM_REQUIRE_TSC
purpose: Runs only the tsc section of the schema test, for runs without the baseline commit.

name: NEWSROOM_RISO_MAP_RINGS
purpose: Stops a one-point map ring from voiding a whole region's halftone dots.

name: NEWSROOM_RPC_FINISH_MS
purpose: Run-time wait limit in milliseconds for the agent finish step; default 30000.

name: NEWSROOM_RPC_HEARTBEAT_MS
purpose: Run-time heartbeat interval in milliseconds for the agent process; default 5000.

name: NEWSROOM_RPC_IDLE_MS
purpose: Run-time idle limit in milliseconds for the agent process; default 300000.

name: NEWSROOM_RPC_STARTUP_MS
purpose: Run-time limit in milliseconds for the agent process to start; default 60000.

name: NEWSROOM_RPC_TOTAL_MS
purpose: Run-time limit in milliseconds for a whole agent run; default 86400000.

name: NEWSROOM_SANKEY_MIXED_UNITS
purpose: A sankey node whose flows mix units is a lint blocker.

name: NEWSROOM_SANKEY_ONE_OTHER
purpose: Extra check: a sankey column holds at most one other-like node.

name: NEWSROOM_SANKEY_OTHER_NOTE
purpose: Names the nodes that a merged other node of a sankey holds.

name: NEWSROOM_SCATTER_PAIRED_MEASURES
purpose: A scatter's two axes each declare one measure and compare as a pair.

name: NEWSROOM_SCENE_DUPLICATE_WORDING
purpose: Changes only the wording of the refusal when a module is written twice.

name: NEWSROOM_SERVICE_TOKEN_2
purpose: Example credential-looking name in the tool host's key-name test; not read as a switch.

name: NEWSROOM_SHARED_AXIS_SEMANTICS
purpose: Dumbbell and slope charts must declare measure semantics and claim spec.

name: NEWSROOM_SIGNED_BARS
purpose: Colours bar and dot marks by sign when the values span zero.

name: NEWSROOM_SIGNED_SCALE
purpose: Gives a value column holding both signs one shared signed colour scale.

name: NEWSROOM_SIGNED_SCALE_CHECK
purpose: Adds report-only critic codes for signed scales; never changes a pass or score.

name: NEWSROOM_SMALL_MULTIPLES_OUTLIER_PANEL
purpose: Adds an outlier panel to small-multiples charts.

name: NEWSROOM_SOURCE_TABLE
purpose: Adds the source table (prompts/source-table.md: optional starting points for time-series and ranking data) after the data-source sentence of the visual delivery contract in the first prompt. Exactly 1 turns it on. Prompt text only: no check changes, a source taken from the table is recorded and validated like any other, and the table grants no verified status.

name: NEWSROOM_SPATIAL_BENCH_ITERATIONS
purpose: Iteration count for the spatial explanatory viz benchmark; default 140.

name: NEWSROOM_SPATIAL_VIZ_P95_MS
purpose: P95 time budget in milliseconds for the spatial viz benchmark; default 22.

name: NEWSROOM_SPEED_ATOMIC_ARTIFACT
purpose: Immutable artifact writers publish complete files at once, so readers never see a half-written file; the same SQL is one computation record whichever tool ran first. Remove the "0" off value after the first verified real full-page run.

name: NEWSROOM_SPEED_AUTO_CHECKS
purpose: Rust agent only, needs atomic writes. After a successful plan call the program itself runs the lint, render and critic calls (and the page preview only when NEWSROOM_TOOL_RESULT_IMAGES is not exactly 0) and appends their results to the plan call's result; a step that fails, is refused or runs past AUTO_STEP_TIMEOUT ends the sequence: auto step limit 120 s (+5 s grace), approved by owner 10-18; re-check after the archive redo measures the actual step times. Model judgments (vision critique, claims, the final verdict) are never run by the program and no result grants a verification status. Row approved by owner 10-18 after five archive replays on cd58435a with 0 refusals. Exactly 0 turns it off; any other value, an empty value or false included, leaves it on. Remove the "0" off value after the first verified real full-page run.

name: NEWSROOM_SPEED_AUTO_PUBLISH_CHECKS
purpose: Rust agent only, needs atomic writes, default off (exactly 1 turns it on). After a successful publication plan call the program itself runs the publication render and publication QA calls and appends their results to the plan call's result; a step that fails, is refused or is not judged ends the sequence and keeps the tool's own text. No check or threshold changes, and no result grants a verification status.

name: NEWSROOM_SYMBOL_MAP
purpose: The symbol_map chart is on unless the value is exactly 0. It draws one circle per region, circle area proportional to the value. The plan names basemap_id; the program fills the basemap source url, licence and hash from that registry entry when omitted (never overwriting what the model wrote; the hash check then compares the registry with itself). Also lets symbol_map through the page grammar table (visual_grammar spatial) and the strict claim relation geography, read once when the runtime loads. Also makes the page render QA carry the symbol map's own spec and rows (read from the chart manifest refs, rows checked against data_hash) and adds a NEW LIMIT: a page lint blocker, at most 1 symbol_map per page (symbol_map_limit); with more than one and lint bypassed, page QA stays red with the reason multiple_symbol_maps. Must be enabled together with NEWSROOM_LOCATION_EVIDENCE (and, when the defaults are flipped, flipped together): without location evidence the symbol-map anchor check is unchecked and only warns. Exactly 0 turns it off; any other value, an empty value or false included, leaves it on. Remove the "0" off value after the first verified real full-page run.

name: NEWSROOM_SYMBOL_MAP_CROP
purpose: With NEWSROOM_SYMBOL_MAP on, frames the symbol map on the area that has data: the box around each circle's label point (and the focus point) plus 12% margin and a minimum span of 24 x 16 degrees (starting values, not from the literature, not trial-run), instead of the outlines of the whole countries. A box that crosses the date line in the world-projection crop tier still shows the whole world map. When cropped, the frame carries data-frame-source=data-extent and the footnote gets one more line saying how many base-layer regions without a data row lie outside the frame; the 'no data row' sentence and count are unchanged. Circles are never allowed outside the frame; if they do not fit the whole base map is drawn. Does not loosen any check. Has no effect unless NEWSROOM_SYMBOL_MAP is on.
